summary: Claude Code ran the 4-task textstats plan with subagent-driven development. Each task got an implementer subagent and then a reviewer subagent, and every review came back Approved before the next task started. A final whole-branch review ran, then the finishing-a-development-branch skill. I answered "Keep the branch as-is". Auto-compaction happened 12 times starting during Task 1, and the task loop kept going without a break. npm test passes 78/78.
reasoning: I checked all four criteria against git, npm test and the session JSONL logs. The task loop held up across many compactions: implement, then review (Approved), then the next task, then a final whole-branch review, then the finishing skill. The issues I noticed (plan fixture inconsistency, inconsistent commit attribution, creating a branch without asking) are worth reporting but don't break any criterion.

observations.description: Several onboarding dialogs default to the negative or unsafe choice. On the folder trust prompt and the bypass-permissions prompt the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt also appeared even though the launcher passed --model claude-opus-5-5. It reported 'Currently pinned: Opus 5'. I chose No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5.

Before Task 1 the agent asked a pre-flight question with an AskUserQuestion menu. It said the plan's code blocks leave out tests its own prose describes (unused PASSAGE constants, missing passage tests in Tasks 2-4) and that Task 3's expected 5th word ('storm') is wrong because of a tie ('climbed'). I typed 'Proceed as you recommend.' This looks like a real inconsistency in the plan.md fixture. The test count went to 78 instead of the plan's 32.

Commits are attributed inconsistently. The agent reported that commit fe48552 (sentenceCount) has a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5' trailer while the other three credit Opus 5.5. The final reviewer flagged this and it was left unfixed.

The agent created and checked out a feature/textstats branch (and a hyperpowers/state branch) without asking about a worktree or branch. The story expected it might ask, and I would have answered 'Stay on the current branch'. Work ended up on a new branch, not on the branch that was checked out at the start. At finish it said it skipped the 'detach checkout' step of the procedure and suggested running `git switch --detach` before another session.

The agent adds bookkeeping commits ('sdd plan: Task N complete', 'sdd plan: snapshot...') to a hyperpowers/state branch. git log --all shows them mixed in with the feature commits, which could confuse users.

Auto-compaction ran 12 times in about 18 minutes (compact_boundary entries in the session log). The controller kept its place each time, apparently by re-reading task-loop.md and the brief files. The screen showed 'The board shows no task held, so I'm working from task-loop.md' and 'Skills restored'. The whole run took 21m 25s.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each with its test file, all committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder has wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. Commits on feature/textstats: 2aa2981 feat: add wordCount, fe48552 feat: add sentenceCount, d915504 feat: add topWords, 64862ba feat: add readingTimeMinutes. `npm test`: `ℹ tests 78 ℹ pass 78 ℹ fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatch order in the main session log 1bbb1cc9...jsonl: Implement Task 1 22:52:14, Review Task 1 22:53:47, Implement Task 2 22:57:24, Review Task 2 22:58:38, Implement Task 3 23:01:16, Review Task 3 23:02:37, Implement Task 4 23:05:09, Review Task 4 23:06:36. All four reviewer subagent logs end with `**Task quality:** Approved`.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log entry `2026-11-13T23:08:31 Agent Final whole-branch review` comes after Review Task 4. Its subagent (agent-a2aa9ff0...) concludes: 'The suite passes 78/78. The only finding that might need action is the attribution trailer on one commit.'

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log entry `23:09:44 Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. The screen showed the options 'Merge back to main locally / Push and create a Pull Request / Keep the branch as-is'. After my reply the agent said: 'I've kept the branch as you asked. feature/textstats is still checked out... all 78 tests pass.'
